what: kè đá Bãi Trước: a piece of 2 m of the sea wall of granite blocks in courses that leans back, from the foot of the low wall of the walk down to the sand
uses: Plan 0026, R4: under the low wall of the beach (tuong_bai_tam) where the sea wall is not a flight of steps: the game puts the pieces one after another along the line, the port end of a piece on the port start of the next, the top edge (the origin) at the foot of the low wall on the side of the sand, the face down to +y. The game scales each piece in height to the drop at its place (the height of the walk less the height of the sand: 0 m to 2.0 m along the line); the run stays 0.3 m.

sources.author: Hữu Nghĩa Nguyễn Huỳnh (beos_album, Flickr)
sources.shows: Bãi Trước at sunset to the south: in the corner a sloped sea wall of rough granite blocks laid in courses along its top edge, the wet sand at its foot, a man with a ball, the boats of the bay, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu.

sources.author: Ted McGrath (time-to-look, Flickr)
sources.shows: Bãi Trước at low tide, a crop of the original: the low wall with its rail and openings on a wall of granite blocks in courses, a band at the level of the walk, and under it a long flight of seven steps of granite down to the sand along the wall; a woman in a nón lá and a man in blue with a crate on the steps; painted fishing boats on the sand.

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with its rail and openings in sections on a sloped face of stone, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

sources.author: Nguyen tan dat Dat (tandat.2301, Flickr)
sources.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the sand (a crop of the original): wide flights of granite steps from the walk down to the sand and the water between the sections of the low wall, seen from the side; on the right a section of the low wall on a footing of concrete, with a short flight of three steps at its end; swim rings, people on the sand.

sources.author: Huy Đi Lang Thang (YouTube)
sources.shows: A walk on the sand of Bãi Trước on a calm morning (the third automatic picture of YouTube, at about 11:00 of 14:37): the end of a section of the sea wall under the low wall, a wall of granite blocks in courses that leans back steeply from the low wall down to the sand, a footing of rough concrete at its end, and a flight of eight courses of steps beside it.

length.source: A piece of the row: I choose 2 m.

height.source: The drop: the height of the walk less the height of the sand in the ground of the game (report 0026, Q17). I measured it along the low wall of the beach: 0 m to 2.0 m, median 1.2 m. The model has the median; the game scales each piece in height to the drop at its place. Photo 1 (2019-01-24) gives 1.43 m at the place of its steps.

run.source: Photo 4 (2020-06-22, 1280 px): the lines of the wall meet at 270 px on the horizon (245 px), and the end of the section shows the face from the top edge to the sand. From the top edge at the end (520, 170) to the foot at the end (460, 545), the face leans back at 80 degrees; from the top edge to the foot at the far end of the visible face (430, 195 to 365, 375), at 69 degrees (a lens of 800 px to 1 100 px). The mean is 75 degrees: the run is 0.27 times the drop. 0.27 × 1.2 m: 0.32 m; 0.3 m.

course.source: estimate (no source): photo 4 shows courses of blocks a little higher than the steps beside them (0.18 m, bac_xuong_cat); with a drop of 1.2 m, four joints under the top edge.

block.source: estimate (no source): photo 0 shows blocks a little longer than those of the low wall.

colors.value: granite #8f8a82, darker and wet near the sand #5a554d, joints #66625b
colors.source: Photo 0 (2019) and photo 2 (2020): grey granite, darker and wet near the sand.

looks.seen: Next to photos 0 to 3: the slope of 35 degrees from the top edge to the sand is as in photo 0. The joints of the blocks show at the mid level: the levels of the edits in a group do not count, only the levels of the group edit. A row of joints is on each end face (dark bands in the side view). The wet band at the foot is weak.
looks.changed: The group edit at the near level only; the joints of each course start a block or a half block in from the end, so no joint is on an end face; the wet band to #5a554d with an opacity of 0.75.

looks.seen: Next to photo 0: the slope from the top edge to the sand, one rough grey, with a darker band at the foot; no joint at the mid level now. The courses of blocks of photo 0 show at the near level only. The footing under the foot is under the sand in the game.
The mid level of the last blueprint: the same as the look before.

Next to photo 0: courses of grey blocks along the top edge with joints a half block apart, darker near the sand. In photo 0 the blocks are rougher and each course stands out a little; here the slope is flat.

Next to photo 4 (2020) and photos 0 to 2 (2019): a wall of 1.2 m that leans back at 75 degrees from the top edge to the sand, one grey, with a darker band at the foot, as the end of the section in photo 4. The old order had a slope of 35 degrees (2.0 m of run): photo 4 shows a much steeper face. In photo 4 the lower half of the face is dark and wet; here the dark band is low and weak.
looks.changed: Nothing at the mid level (the drop of 1.2 m and the run of 0.3 m come from the ground of the game and photo 4). Next: the near level.

looks.seen: Next to photo 4: four courses of grey blocks with joints a half block apart on a face that leans back, as the wall of blocks in photo 4. In photo 4 the blocks are rougher, and the lower half is dark and wet.
Report 0026, Q25: the files of the lock of World e8754d6 (build/look/ke_da_bai_truoc_mid.png). The sea wall of granite blocks that leans back, under the low wall, as in photos 0 and 2.
Report 0026, Q25: the files of the lock of World e8754d6 (build/look/ke_da_bai_truoc_far.png). The same face, one grey.

status_note: Source (report 0026, Q17). Rule 2: photos 0 and 1 (2019) and photo 4 (2020) show the wall of granite blocks in courses under the low wall; the drop comes from the ground of the game, and the run from photo 4. The course and the block are estimates (no source); they show at the near level only. On 2026-11-17 the image of photo 2 (VnExpress) did not open, so I did not use it.
